assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are not yet published in the cleared site package; this submission uses the repository provisional boundaries labeled official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint, boundary_precision=provisional_rough.
assumptions.impact: All geometry layers and area metrics (site_area_sqm, key area areas, land use shares, ratios) must be recalculated when official polygons arrive. Provisional geometry is not an official redline, approval basis, or precise-area basis.

assumptions.statement: Building floors (floors_est) and total_floor_area_sqm_est are concept-level estimates derived from building footprint blocks; they are not approved regulatory floor area.
assumptions.impact: total_floor_area_sqm_est, building_density and building_footprint_area_sqm are design-proposal estimates with medium/low confidence, to be replaced by official regulatory-plan conditions.

assumptions.statement: road_area_sqm_est uses a uniform 10m half-buffer on design road centerlines; official road redlines, station entrances, utility lines, fire access, and parking supply are pending.
assumptions.impact: Road area is an order-of-magnitude estimate; traffic and municipal conclusions are concept-level until official redlines and engineering data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: All sources used are public or user-provided cleared data per data/source_registry.json; no internal or non-public spatial data, personal data, or unlicensed media are used.
assumptions.impact: Formal claims rely on formal-ready sources; background-only and provisional-only sources are labeled as such and never upgraded to official boundaries, statutory controls, or implementation commitments.
